parsed.summary: This paper proposes LLM4AIGQ, an LLM-based framework for generating personalized AI guidance queries by mining users' multi-interests. The framework uses a three-stage SFT-RL-DPO training pipeline with multi-level rewards to optimize interest segmentation and query generation. Experimental results show that LLM4AIGQ significantly improves user click-through rates in online A/B tests and outperforms various baseline models in offline evaluations.

chk_problem.value: Traditional AI-generated query generation suffers from semantic drift and fails to capture users' diverse interests, leading to low-value guidance queries.
chk_problem.paper_quote: This approach suffers from semantic drift due to information cascade loss; additionally, primary search query derivation heavily depends on "user-item" co-occurrence relationships, lacking exploration of user multi-interests, resulting in guidance queries with low value and mismatched purchase intent.

chk_method.value: LLM4AIGQ, an LLM-based framework that uses a three-stage SFT-RL-DPO training pipeline to segment user interests and generate personalized AI guidance queries.
chk_method.paper_quote: We propose LLM4AIGQ, an LLM-based framework for multi-interest-aware AI guidance query generation, addressing cascading information loss and insufficient personalized intent modeling in traditional pipelines.

chk_data.value: User interaction logs from Taobao and Tmall (June-July 2026), including 8,000 short-title instances, 11,259 SFT instances, 3,000 RL samples, 3,500 DPO samples, and 1,000 test samples.
chk_data.paper_quote: Our datasets are sampled from multi-behavior user interaction logs on the Taobao and Tmall e-commerce platforms, covering the period from June to July 2026.

chk_setup.value: Qwen3-30B-A3B backbone trained on NVIDIA H20 GPUs with LoRA rank 16, using specific batch sizes and learning rates across SFT, RL, and DPO stages.
chk_setup.paper_quote: LLM4AIGQ adopts Qwen3-30B-A3B as the backbone model and is trained on NVIDIA H20 GPUs.

chk_primary_result.value: In online A/B tests, the proposed method achieved a 4.46% improvement in uCTR in the initial 10% traffic experiment, and a 2.53% gain at 40% traffic.
chk_primary_result.paper_quote: In the initial 10% traffic experiment, the experimental group achieved a 4.46% improvement in uCTR compared with the baseline bucket.

chk_secondary_result.value: In pairwise evaluations against the teacher model, the RL-trained model achieved a win rate of 57.53%, outperforming the teacher model.
chk_secondary_result.paper_quote: After RL, the win rate further increases to 57.53%, allowing the student model to surpass the teacher.

chk_baseline.value: Zero-shot LLMs (such as Qwen3, GPT-oss, and Deepseek-V4-Pro) and different SFT/RL variants of the proposed LLM4AIGQ model.
chk_baseline.paper_quote: We compare LLM4AIGQ with two major types of baselines: (1) zero-shot LLMs, including several advanced models and larger variants from the same model family, all evaluated without any domain adaptation; and (2) variants of LLM4AIGQ.

chk_conclusion.value: The LLM4AIGQ framework successfully segments user interests and generates high-quality shopping guidance queries, achieving significant performance gains in online deployment.
chk_conclusion.paper_quote: The framework can autonomously disentangle user interests and generate high-quality shopping guidance queries tailored to users’ consumption intentions, and capabilities.

chk_limitation.value: There is a trade-off between reasoning quality and inference efficiency when transitioning from thinking mode to non-thinking mode.
chk_limitation.paper_quote: The small decline reflects a trade-off between reasoning quality and inference efficiency, while most RL-acquired capability is preserved.
